<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Booking details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PreTravelReminder" name="Pre-travel reminder and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails" name="Submit booking details" sourceRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails" targetRef="Start_BookingReceived" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Send ticket by email or SMS" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Send pre-travel reminder and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Start_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SearchTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRoute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitBookingDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteJourney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostTravelServices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_JourneyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PostTravelComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_ReminderReception</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Search" name="Customer searches for a ticket">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select route, date, and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitBookingDetails" name="Submit booking details" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_Customer_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravelServices" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use services">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JourneyComplete" name="Journey complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReminderReception" name="Receive any pre-travel reminders and instructions" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Reminder">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ReminderCustomer" name="Customer">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ReminderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReminderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReminderReceived" name="Receive pre-travel reminder and instructions">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Reminder" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReminderReceived" name="Reminder received">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_1</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_1" sourceRef="Start_ReminderReceived" targetRef="End_ReminderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Search" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_SubmitBookingDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravelServices">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">postTravelFollowUp</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="End_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_PostTravelServices" targetRef="End_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Ticket booking and inventory update" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BookingReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_TicketSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Reminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ReminderSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BookingReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Booking" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Continue ticket delivery and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TicketSent" name="Ticket sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder" name="Send pre-travel reminder?" default="Flow_Company_8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_PreTravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReminderSent" name="Reminder sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_9</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoReminder" name="Inventory updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="Start_BookingReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="End_TicketSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reminderNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder" targetRef="End_NoReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_9" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="End_ReminderSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
